params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated properties to be provided in response.The field names should be from the first level of property names as defined in Customer schema.

params.name: csrId
params.description: It is logged in csr id and it is mandatory when List of VIP and Enterprise is fetched.

params.name: sortKey
params.description: To sort the response based on sortkeys. Possible values name. Values will be retrieved from RT perestapi.imp.cust.SORT_KEY

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: To sort the response based on sort order. Possible value ascending, descending

params.name: retrievalType
params.description: Type of retrieval of data. 1 -> retrieves the list of all object keys along with the number of object details mentioned in retrievalLimit, 2 -> retrieves the list of all object keys, 3 -> retrieves object details for the keys mentioned in objKeys

params.name: retrievalLimit
params.description: Limit to the number of objects retrieved. Mandatory when retrievalType is 1

params.name: objKeys
params.description: Comma-separated object keys for which details to be retrieved. Mandatory when retrievalType is 3

params.name: customerType
params.description: To retrieve the customers by type - SV_MAPPING:Cust_Acct_Type.DisplayName_X - RT api.imp.ALL_CC_CUSTOMER_TYPE. Can be used together with retrievalType parameter or as additional parameter to searchKey and searchValue

params.name: customerRank
params.description: It tells if VIP list of customers are needed to be retrieved. Possible Value: VIP. Can be used together with retrievalType parameter

params.name: listEntCustFlag
params.description: It tells if list of enterprise customers are needed to be retrieved. Possible Value: 1. Can be used together with retrievalType parameter

params.name: searchKey
params.description: Search Keys on which data needs to be filtered. Valid Values: Name | MSISDN | IMSI | National ID | Account Number | Company Number | Passport ID. These values will be retrieved from RT perestapi.imp.cust.GlobalSrchFilters. Can be used together with retrievalType parameter

params.name: searchValue
params.description: Value of the searchKey passed. Mandatory when searchKey is use.

params.name: rootNodeId
params.description: To retrieve the customers by root customer node id - SV_MAPPING: Cust_Acct.RootCustAcct_R. Can be used together with retrievalType parameter or as additional parameter to searchKey and searchValue.

params.name: parentNodeId
params.description: To retrieve the customers by parent customer node id - SV_MAPPING: Cust_Acct.ParentCustAcct_R. Can be used together with retrievalType parameter or as additional parameter to searchKey and searchValue.

params.name: individualId
params.description: To retrieve customer by Individual Id - SV_MAPPING:CustAcct_Contact.Contact.XSID. Can be used together with retrievalType parameter or with additional parameter customerType, rootNodeId or parentNodeId.

params.name: reason
params.description: The reason for which API is called. Valid values: BalanceTransfer. This value will be retrieved from RT perestapi.REASON. It is used with searchKey is Account Number
